blocks.text: Patrick Garcia opened up about his current circumstances with Jazz, his son with Jennylyn Mercado, revealing that he has not spent time with him and provided financial support since 2017 amid the actress’ alleged unresponsiveness to his efforts to reach her. Garcia spoke about this during a recent interview vlog with Ogie Diaz, where he denied claims that he abandoned Mercado during her pregnancy with Jazz.
